rows.label: Formula
rows.text:
F = k q₁q₂/r²
E = F/q
∮E·dA = Q/ε₀

rows.label: Conditions
rows.text: ❌ treat "Coulomb's law" as one blob → ✅ split into: coulomb's law, its applications.  ·  ❌ state the rule without its limit → ✅ note when it applies / stops applying.

rows.label: Special cases
rows.text: Coulomb: F = (1/4πε₀)·q₁q₂/r². Electric field E = F/q = kq/r²; for a line/dipole use superposition.  ·  Gauss's law: ∮E·dA = Q_enc/ε₀ — powerful for spherical/cylindrical/planar symmetry.
